detail: Snap election called on 5 October 2022 after the Social Liberals demanded one following the Mink Commission report. The red bloc kept a one-seat majority, but she resigned as promised to seek a government across the centre and formed the SVM coalition with Venstre and the Moderates on 15 December 2022.

role_sought: Member of the Folketing and prime-ministerial candidate, Social Democrats, Nordjyllands Storkreds
result: Re-elected; re-appointed Prime Minister on 3 June 2026
vote_share: 41,721 personal votes; Social Democrats nationally 779,252 votes (21.8%), 38 seats (in Nordjyllands Storkreds 27.8%)
opponent: Troels Lund Poulsen (Venstre), blue-bloc candidate for prime minister
detail: Snap election called on 26 February 2026. The Social Democrats stayed the largest party but had their weakest result since 1903; neither bloc won a majority, and the Moderates held the balance. Turnout was 83.99%. The king first tasked Frederiksen with leading negotiations (25 March), then Troels Lund Poulsen (8 May), whose talks failed, and again Frederiksen (23 May); she announced a four-party government on 1 June 2026.
